verses.original: כְּרָפְאִ֣י לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְנִגְלָ֞ה עֲוֺ֤ן אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וְרָע֣וֹת שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י פָעֲל֖וּ שָׁ֑קֶר וְגַנָּ֣ב יָב֔וֹא פָּשַׁ֥ט גְּד֖וּד בַּחֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·rā·p̄ə·’î lə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·niḡ·lāh ‘ă·wōn ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·rā·‘ō·wṯ šō·mə·rō·wn kî p̄ā·‘ă·lū šā·qer wə·ḡan·nāḇ yā·ḇō·w pā·šaṭ gə·ḏūḏ ba·ḥūṣ
verses.literal: When I heal Israel the iniquity of Ephraim will be exposed as well as the crimes of Samaria For they practice deceit and thieves break in bandits raid in the streets
verses.literalPt: SARANDO eu a Israel, se descobriu a iniqüidade de Efraim, como também as maldades de Samaria, porque praticaram a falsidade; e o ladrão entra, e a horda dos salteadores despoja por fora.

verses.original: וּבַל־ יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ לִלְבָבָ֔ם כָּל־ רָעָתָ֖ם זָכָ֑רְתִּי עַתָּה֙ סְבָב֣וּם מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם נֶ֥גֶד פָּנַ֖י הָיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇal- yō·mə·rū lil·ḇā·ḇām kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām zā·ḵā·rə·tî ‘at·tāh sə·ḇā·ḇūm ma·‘al·lê·hem ne·ḡeḏ pā·nay hā·yū
verses.literal: But they fail to consider in their hearts that I remember all their evil Now their deeds are all around them they are before My face
verses.literalPt: E não dizem no seu coração que eu me lembro de toda a sua maldade; agora, pois, os cercam as suas obras; diante da minha face estão.

verses.literal: They delight the king with their evil and the princes with their lies
verses.literalPt: Com a sua malícia alegram ao rei, e com as suas mentiras aos príncipes.

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים כְּמ֣וֹ תַנּ֔וּר בֹּעֵ֖רָה מֵֽאֹפֶ֑ה יִשְׁבּ֣וֹת מֵעִ֔יר מִלּ֥וּשׁ בָּצֵ֖ק עַד־ חֻמְצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām mə·nā·’ă·p̄îm kə·mōw ṯan·nūr bō·‘ê·rāh mê·’ō·p̄eh yiš·bō·wṯ mê·‘îr mil·lūš bā·ṣêq ‘aḏ- ḥum·ṣā·ṯōw
verses.literal: They are all adulterers like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough
verses.literalPt: Todos eles são adúlteros; são semelhantes ao forno aceso pelo padeiro, que cessa de mexer nas brasas, depois que amassou a massa, até que seja levedada.

verses.original: י֣וֹם מַלְכֵּ֔נוּ הֶחֱל֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים חֲמַ֣ת מִיָּ֑יִן מָשַׁ֥ךְ יָד֖וֹ אֶת־ לֹצְצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm mal·kê·nū he·ḥĕ·lū śā·rîm ḥă·maṯ mî·yā·yin mā·šaḵ yā·ḏōw ’eṯ- lō·ṣə·ṣîm
verses.literal: The princes are inflamed . . . with wine on the day of our king so he joins hands . . . with those who mock him
verses.literalPt: E no dia do nosso rei os príncipes se tornaram doentes com frascos de vinho; ele estendeu a sua mão com os escarnecedores.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קֵרְב֧וּ כַתַּנּ֛וּר לִבָּ֖ם בְּאָרְבָּ֑ם כָּל־ הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ יָשֵׁ֣ן אֹֽפֵהֶ֔ם בֹּ֕קֶר ה֥וּא בֹעֵ֖ר כְּאֵ֥שׁ לֶהָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- qê·rə·ḇū ḵat·tan·nūr lib·bām bə·’ā·rə·bām kāl- hal·lay·lāh yā·šên ’ō·p̄ê·hem bō·qer hū ḇō·‘êr kə·’êš le·hā·ḇāh
verses.literal: For they prepare their heart like an oven while they lie in wait all night their anger smolders in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire
verses.literalPt: Porque, prepararam o coração como um forno, na sua emboscada; toda a noite dorme o seu padeiro, pela manhã arde como fogo de chama.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤ם יֵחַ֙מּוּ֙ כַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְאָכְל֖וּ אֶת־ שֹֽׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם כָּל־ מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם נָפָ֔לוּ אֵין־ קֹרֵ֥א בָהֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām yê·ḥam·mū kat·tan·nūr wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- šō·p̄ə·ṭê·hem kāl- mal·ḵê·hem nā·p̄ā·lū ’ên- qō·rê ḇā·hem ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: All of them are hot as an oven and they devour their rulers All their kings fall not one of them calls upon Me
verses.literalPt: Todos eles estão quentes como um forno, e consomem os seus juízes; todos os seus reis caem, ninguém entre eles há que me invoque.

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם בָּעַמִּ֖ים ה֣וּא יִתְבּוֹלָ֑ל אֶפְרַ֛יִם הָיָ֥ה עֻגָ֖ה בְּלִ֥י הֲפוּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim bā·‘am·mîm hū yiṯ·bō·w·lāl ’ep̄·ra·yim hā·yāh ‘u·ḡāh bə·lî hă·p̄ū·ḵāh
verses.literal: Ephraim mixes with the nations Ephraim is an unturned cake
verses.literalPt: Efraim se mistura com os povos; Efraim é um bolo que não foi virado.

verses.original: אָכְל֤וּ זָרִים֙ כֹּח֔וֹ וְה֖וּא לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע גַּם־ שֵׂיבָה֙ זָ֣רְקָה בּ֔וֹ וְה֖וּא לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵə·lū zā·rîm kō·ḥōw wə·hū lō yā·ḏā‘ gam- śê·ḇāh zā·rə·qāh bōw wə·hū lō yā·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Foreigners consume his strength but he does not notice Even his hair is streaked with gray but he does not know
verses.literalPt: Estrangeiros lhe comeram a força, e ele não o sabe; também as cãs se espalharam sobre ele, e não o sabe.

verses.original: וְעָנָ֥ה גְאֽוֹן־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּפָנָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֙בוּ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א בִקְשֻׁ֖הוּ בְּכָל־ זֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nāh ḡə·’ō·wn- yiś·rā·’êl bə·p̄ā·nāw wə·lō- šā·ḇū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·lō ḇiq·šu·hū bə·ḵāl zōṯ
verses.literal: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them yet they do not return to the LORD their God despite all this they do not seek Him
verses.literalPt: E a soberba de Israel testificará diante dele; todavia não voltarão para o SENHOR seu Deus, nem o buscarão em tudo isto.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם כְּיוֹנָ֥ה פוֹתָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב מִצְרַ֥יִם קָרָ֖אוּ אַשּׁ֥וּר הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’ep̄·ra·yim kə·yō·w·nāh p̄ō·w·ṯāh ’ên lêḇ miṣ·ra·yim qā·rā·’ū ’aš·šūr hā·lā·ḵū
verses.literal: So Ephraim has become like a silly senseless . . . dove calling out to Egypt then turning to Assyria
verses.literalPt: Porque Efraim é como uma pomba ingênua, sem entendimento; invocam o Egito, vão para a Assíria.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵלֵ֗כוּ אֶפְר֤וֹשׂ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ רִשְׁתִּ֔י כְּע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אֽוֹרִידֵ֑ם אַיְסִרֵ֕ם כְּשֵׁ֖מַע לַעֲדָתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer yê·lê·ḵū ’ep̄·rō·wś ‘ă·lê·hem riš·tî kə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ’ō·w·rî·ḏêm ’ay·si·rêm kə·šê·ma‘ la·‘ă·ḏā·ṯām
verses.literal: As they go I will spread My net over them I will bring them down like birds of the air I will chastise them when I hear them flocking together
verses.literalPt: Quando forem, sobre eles estenderei a minha rede, e como aves do céu os farei descer; castigá-los-ei, conforme o que eles têm ouvido na sua congregação.

verses.original: א֤וֹי לָהֶם֙ כִּֽי־ נָדְד֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נִּי שֹׁ֥ד לָהֶ֖ם כִּֽי־ פָ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶפְדֵּ֔ם וְהֵ֕מָּה דִּבְּר֥וּ עָלַ֖י כְּזָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lā·hem kî- nā·ḏə·ḏū mim·men·nî šōḏ lā·hem kî- p̄ā·šə·‘ū ḇî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’ep̄·dêm wə·hêm·māh dib·bə·rū ‘ā·lay kə·zā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Woe to them for they have strayed from Me Destruction to them for they have rebelled against Me Though I would redeem them . . . they speak lies against Me
verses.literalPt: Ai deles, porque fugiram de mim; destruição sobre eles, porque se rebelaram contra mim; eu os remi, mas disseram mentiras contra mim.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ זָעֲק֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בְּלִבָּ֔ם כִּ֥י יְיֵלִ֖ילוּ עַל־ מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑ם עַל־ דָּגָ֧ן וְתִיר֛וֹשׁ יִתְגּוֹרָ֖רוּ יָס֥וּרוּ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- zā·‘ă·qū ’ê·lay bə·lib·bām kî yə·yê·lî·lū ‘al- miš·kə·ḇō·w·ṯām ‘al- dā·ḡān wə·ṯî·rō·wōš yiṯ·gō·w·rā·rū yā·sū·rū ḇî
verses.literal: They do not cry out to Me from their hearts when they wail upon their beds They slash themselves for grain and new wine but turn away from Me
verses.literalPt: E não clamaram a mim com seu coração, mas davam uivos nas suas camas; para o trigo e para o vinho se ajuntam, mas contra mim se rebelam.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יִסַּ֔רְתִּי חִזַּ֖קְתִּי זְרֽוֹעֹתָ֑ם וְאֵלַ֖י יְחַשְּׁבוּ־ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî yis·sar·tî ḥiz·zaq·tî zə·rō·w·‘ō·ṯām wə·’ê·lay yə·ḥaš·šə·ḇū- rā‘
verses.literal: Although I trained and strengthened their arms they plot evil against Me
verses.literalPt: Eu os corrigi, e lhes esforcei os braços, mas pensam mal contra mim.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ׀ לֹ֣א עָ֗ל הָיוּ֙ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּ֔ה יִפְּל֥וּ בַחֶ֛רֶב שָׂרֵיהֶ֖ם מִזַּ֣עַם לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם ז֥וֹ לַעְגָּ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šū·ḇū lō ‘āl hā·yū kə·qe·šeṯ rə·mî·yāh yip·pə·lū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ śā·rê·hem miz·za·‘am lə·šō·w·nām zōw la‘·gām bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: They turn but not to the Most High they are like a faulty bow Their leaders will fall by the sword for the cursing of their tongue for this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Eles voltaram, mas não para o Altíssimo. Fizeram-se como um arco enganador; caem à espada os seus príncipes, por causa do furor da sua língua; este será o seu escárnio na terra do Egito.
